sections.what_happened: Russian forces struck a residential apartment building in Kharkiv's Osnovianskyi district late Tuesday Oct 27 (drone strike per UNN/regional administration), injuring 4 people: women aged 32 and 65, a 56-year-old man, and a 4-year-old boy; 3 hospitalized. Fires in a two-story industrial building, a two-story apartment building and a one-story house; a private home and a vehicle also damaged. This RESOLVES the timestamp problem in the 0700-03 HOLD: the strike is now timestamped (Oct 27 23:45 Ukrinform; UNN published Oct 28 00:01+02:00) and the casualty figures match across Kyiv Post, UNN and Ukrinform. The 0700-03 HOLD's second headline (Zelensky urges US to end Patriot delay) still duplicates Zelenskyy's Oct 27 statement already recorded (16 ballistic missiles / 280+ drones item) and is NOT revived here.
sections.what_verified: Ukrinform (T2, STATE UA) carries the strike; Kyiv Post (no declared tier -- does not count) and UNN (no declared tier -- does not count) agree on identical casualty figures; the underlying primary sources are the Kharkiv mayor and regional military administration (T1 national/local officials). Counting distinct declared families: Ukrinform + the primary official source = 2.
sections.what_disputed: No Russian statement on this specific strike retrieved; Russia denies deliberately targeting civilians (standing position, recorded in prior scans). The strike is a single nightly incident, not evidence of a new campaign phase.
sections.why_matters: A child among the injured in Kharkiv -- the strike the 07:00 scan held for lack of a timestamp is now timestamped, second-sourced and casualty-confirmed. Say it as one nightly strike, not a new offensive.
